_comment: MCP-PAGE M3-1. The two PUBLIC juwri MCP servers, ready to publish to the official registry (registry.modelcontextprotocol.io). Token-auth servers (Admin, Storefront, Customer) are intentionally EXCLUDED from v1 — the registry lists servers a client can connect to without credentials. Replace 'juwri.com' with the exact domain you will prove ownership of (DNS TXT or HTTP challenge); the namespace host and the remotes host must match that domain. mcp-publisher publishes ONE server per call — see RUNBOOK.md.

servers.name: com.juwri/catalog-mcp
servers.description: Discover restaurants across the juwri platform: search stores, search dishes cross-store, and get a store's details with a deep-link hint into its storefront ordering server. Public, read-only; lists only active, publicly-listed stores and never exposes owner PII.

servers.name: com.juwri/dev-mcp
servers.description: Build on juwri from any MCP-capable editor: searchable developer + help docs, the authoritative generated Liquid theme reference, section-schema format, and server-side theme validation with the marketplace's own rules. Public, read-only (plus a docs-feedback tool).
